# @amezquita/design-system — full reference

> Token-first, multi-brand design system — DTCG tokens, Style Dictionary, CI-enforced linting/contrast/accessibility, Figma sync, and agent-safe governance.

## Install

```bash
npm install @amezquita/design-system
```

## Tokens

537 tokens total, resolved across light/dark × default/bold. Full values: https://amezquita.dk/tokens.json

- component: 405
- color: 45
- typography: 28
- primitive: 18
- size: 8
- spacing: 8
- motion: 7
- elevation: 6
- shadow: 5
- radius: 4
- opacity: 2
- border: 1

## Primitives

### Avatar

User profile picture with fallback to initials when no image is provided

- Import: `import { Avatar } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/primitives/Avatar'`
- Token prefix: `avatar-*` (14 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Avatar
- Stories: WithImage, WithFallback, WithCustomFallback, AllSizes, Group, GroupWithOverflow, DarkMode

### Badge

Small status indicator or numeric count overlay attached to another element

- Import: `import { Badge } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/primitives/Badge'`
- Token prefix: `badge-*` (24 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Badge
- Stories: Default, Count, Dot, AllVariants, AllShapes, AllVariantsAllShapes, DarkMode

### Button

Trigger for user actions; renders as `<button>` or `<a>` depending on context

- Import: `import { Button } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/primitives/Button'`
- Token prefix: `button-*` (30 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Button
- Stories: Primary, Secondary, Ghost, Link, Loading, LoadingSecondary, FullWidth, WithIcon, Disabled, AllVariants, AllStates, DarkMode

### Checkbox

Single boolean selection with an associated label; supports indeterminate state

- Import: `import { Checkbox } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/primitives/Checkbox'`
- Token prefix: `checkbox-*` (14 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Checkbox
- Stories: Default, Checked, Indeterminate, Disabled, DisabledChecked, Controlled, AllStates, NoLabel, DarkMode

### Input

Labelled single-line text entry with hint and error states

- Import: `import { Input } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/primitives/Input'`
- Token prefix: `input-*` (22 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Input
- Stories: Default, WithHint, WithError, Disabled, NoLabel, WithPrefix, WithSuffix, Clearable, Search, AllStates, DarkMode

### Label

Standalone form label element — used when a label must be decoupled from its input

- Import: `import { Label } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/primitives/Label'`
- Token prefix: `label-*` (6 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Label
- Stories: Default, Required, Disabled, AllVariants, DarkMode

### Radio

Single-selection control within a mutually exclusive group

- Import: `import { Radio } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/primitives/Radio'`
- Token prefix: `radio-*` (14 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Radio
- Stories: Default, WithDefault, Horizontal, Disabled, WithDisabledOption, Controlled, AllStates, DarkMode

### Select

Dropdown for choosing a single value from a list; supports grouped options

- Import: `import { Select } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/primitives/Select'`
- Token prefix: `select-*` (20 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Select
- Stories: Default, WithDefaultValue, Grouped, Disabled, DarkMode

### Skeleton

Placeholder loading state that mirrors the geometry of the content it replaces

- Import: `import { Skeleton } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/primitives/Skeleton'`
- Token prefix: `skeleton-*` (7 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Skeleton
- Stories: Text, MultiLine, Circle, Rect, CardSkeleton, DarkMode

### Spinner

Indeterminate loading indicator for in-progress operations

- Import: `import { Spinner } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/primitives/Spinner'`
- Token prefix: `spinner-*` (5 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Spinner
- Stories: Default, AllSizes, OnColoredBackground, DarkMode

### Switch

Binary toggle for on/off settings; renders as a styled checkbox under the hood

- Import: `import { Switch } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/primitives/Switch'`
- Token prefix: `switch-*` (14 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Switch
- Stories: Default, Checked, Disabled, DisabledChecked, NoLabel, Controlled, AllStates, DarkMode

### Tag

Inline label for categorising or annotating content — non-interactive

- Import: `import { Tag } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/primitives/Tag'`
- Token prefix: `tag-*` (15 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Tag
- Stories: Default, Accent, Muted, WithIcon, Removable, AllVariants, InContext, DarkMode

### Textarea

Multi-line text entry with label, hint, and error states — mirrors Input API

- Import: `import { Textarea } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/primitives/Textarea'`
- Token prefix: `textarea-*` (19 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Textarea
- Stories: Default, WithHint, WithError, Disabled, WithCharacterCount, AllStates, DarkMode

## Composition

### Alert

Contextual inline feedback message with semantic severity levels (info, success, warning, error)

- Import: `import { Alert } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/composition/Alert'`
- Token prefix: `alert-*` (23 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Alert
- Stories: Default, AllVariants, Dismissible, NoTitle, NoIcon, DarkMode

### Card

Compound container for grouped content — composed from named sub-components

- Import: `import { Card } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/composition/Card'`
- Token prefix: `card-*` (14 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Card
- Stories: Default, Ghost, Interactive, Horizontal, Compact, Featured, WithBody, WithMedia, AllVariants, DarkMode

### Dialog

Overlay for tasks or information requiring focused attention

- Import: `import { Dialog } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/composition/Dialog'`
- Token prefix: `dialog-*` (19 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Dialog
- Stories: Default, Small, Large, Scrollable, WithForm, NoDescription, AllSizes, DarkMode

### Drawer

Side-anchored slide-in panel for supplemental content or secondary navigation

- Import: `import { Drawer } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/composition/Drawer'`
- Token prefix: `drawer-*` (21 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Drawer
- Stories: Default, FilterPanel, AllSides, Sizes, DarkMode

### Toast

Ephemeral notification pushed to a corner of the viewport; auto-dismisses after a timeout

- Import: `import { Toast } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/composition/Toast'`
- Token prefix: `toast-*` (22 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Toast
- Stories: Default, AllVariants, TitleOnly, DarkMode

### Tooltip

Contextual label revealed on hover or focus — supplements an icon or truncated text

- Import: `import { Tooltip } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/composition/Tooltip'`
- Token prefix: `tooltip-*` (13 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Tooltip
- Stories: Default, AllSides, IconButtons, LongContent, NoDelay, DarkMode

## Patterns

### Accordion

Collapsible content sections with animated expand/collapse; supports single or multi-open modes

- Import: `import { Accordion } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/patterns/Accordion'`
- Token prefix: `accordion-*` (15 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Accordion
- Stories: Default, Multiple, WithDisabledItem, DefaultOpen, DarkMode

### Breadcrumb

Hierarchical page location trail; the last item is the current page (non-linked)

- Import: `import { Breadcrumb } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/patterns/Breadcrumb'`
- Token prefix: `breadcrumb-*` (8 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Breadcrumb
- Stories: Default, TwoLevels, SingleLevel, CustomSeparator, LongLabels, DarkMode

### DataTable

Sortable, filterable, paginated table for structured datasets

- Import: `import { DataTable } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/patterns/DataTable'`
- Token prefix: `datatable-*` (3 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/DataTable
- Stories: Default, Sortable, WithSelection, WithPagination, WithPaginationAndSelection, Striped, Compact, Empty, DarkMode

### EmptyState

Placeholder for zero-content states — icon, heading, supporting text, and an optional action

- Import: `import { EmptyState } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/patterns/EmptyState'`
- Token prefix: `emptystate-*` (0 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/EmptyState
- Stories: Default, AllVariants, Compact, DarkMode

### Hero

Page-level section header with eyebrow, title, lead text, and an action slot

- Import: `import { Hero } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/patterns/Hero'`
- Token prefix: `hero-*` (14 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Hero
- Stories: Default, WithEyebrowAndLead, Centered, TitleOnly, PageHeader, DarkMode

### Pagination

Page navigation controls for multi-page data sets; exposes current page and total page count

- Import: `import { Pagination } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/patterns/Pagination'`
- Token prefix: `pagination-*` (12 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Pagination
- Stories: Default, EdgeCases, Compact, DarkMode

### Table

Static data table with semantic header, body, and row structure

- Import: `import { Table } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/patterns/Table'`
- Token prefix: `table-*` (17 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Table
- Stories: Default, Striped, Bordered, Compact, AllVariants, WithCaption, WithFoot, HorizontalScroll, DarkMode

### Tabs

Segmented view switcher with full keyboard navigation; built on Radix Tabs

- Import: `import { Tabs } from '@amezquita/design-system/components/patterns/Tabs'`
- Token prefix: `tabs-*` (20 tokens)
- Storybook: Components/Tabs
- Stories: Default, AllVariants, Sizes, WithDisabledTab, DarkMode
